# OpenTEMPEST library reference

Reference pages for every package, model, block and function in OpenTEMPEST. Each page lists the classes of one package with their description, parameters and connectors.

The pages are generated from the Modelica source and the Dymola documentation export by [`docs/tools/build_reference.py`](../tools/build_reference.py). See [Writing documentation](../DocumentationStyle.md) for how to document a model.
